<file path="frontend-ui/src/components/layout/Layout.tsx">
import React from 'react';
import { Link, useLocation } from 'react-router-dom';

interface LayoutProps {
  children: React.ReactNode;
  onLogout: () => void;
}

export default function Layout({ children, onLogout }: LayoutProps) {
  const location = useLocation();

  const navItems = [
    { name: 'Dashboard', path: '/', icon: 'dashboard' },
    { name: 'AI Command Center', path: '/command-center', icon: 'psychology' },
    { name: 'Match Results', path: '/match-results', icon: 'leaderboard' },
  ];

  return (
    <div className="antialiased min-h-screen flex flex-col bg-background text-on-background font-body-md dark">
      {/* TopNavBar Component */}
      <header className="bg-surface dark:bg-surface-container text-primary-container dark:text-primary-fixed-dim font-body-md text-body-md border-b border-outline-variant dark:border-outline shadow-sm dark:shadow-none flex justify-between items-center px-8 h-16 w-full fixed top-0 z-50">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
          <span className="font-headline-md text-headline-md font-bold text-primary-container dark:text-primary-fixed">MatchInfluence AI</span>
        </div>
        
        <div className="hidden md:flex items-center gap-8 h-full">
          {navItems.map(item => (
            <Link 
              key={item.path}
              to={item.path}
              className={`h-full flex items-center px-4 transition-colors cursor-pointer active:opacity-80 ${location.pathname === item.path ? 'text-primary-container dark:text-primary-fixed-dim font-bold border-b-2 border-primary-container' : 'text-on-surface-variant dark:text-on-surface-variant hover:bg-surface-container-low dark:hover:bg-surface-container-high'}`}
            >
              {item.name}
            </Link>
          ))}
        </div>
        
        <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
          <div className="text-on-surface-variant font-label-md text-label-md hidden sm:block">System Online</div>
          <button onClick={onLogout} className="bg-surface-container-lowest text-on-surface border border-outline-variant rounded px-3 py-1 text-sm hover:bg-surface-container-low transition-all">Logout</button>
          <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-full overflow-hidden bg-surface-variant border border-outline-variant">
            <img alt="User profile" className="w-full h-full object-cover" src="https://ui-avatars.com/api/?name=Executive&background=1e293b&color=fff" />
          </div>
        </div>
      </header>

      {/* SideNavBar Component - Hidden on Mobile */}
      <aside className="hidden md:flex bg-surface-container-lowest dark:bg-surface-container-low text-primary-container dark:text-primary-fixed-dim font-label-md text-label-md fixed left-0 h-full w-64 border-r border-outline-variant dark:border-outline flex-col p-4 z-40 mt-16 pt-8">
        <button className="bg-primary-container text-on-primary rounded flex items-center justify-center gap-2 p-2 w-full mb-8 shadow-sm hover:bg-opacity-90 transition-all">
          <span className="material-symbols-outlined" style={{ fontVariationSettings: "'FILL' 1" }}>add</span>
          New Campaign
        </button>
        
        <nav className="flex-1 space-y-2">
          {navItems.map(item => (
            <Link 
              key={item.path}
              to={item.path}
              className={`flex items-center gap-4 p-2 transition-all rounded-lg scale-95 active:scale-90 ${location.pathname === item.path ? 'bg-secondary-container dark:bg-secondary text-on-secondary-container dark:text-on-secondary font-bold' : 'text-on-surface-variant dark:text-on-surface-variant hover:bg-surface-container-high dark:hover:bg-surface-container-highest'}`}
            >
              <span className="material-symbols-outlined">{item.icon}</span>
              {item.name}
            </Link>
          ))}
        </nav>
        
        <div className="mt-auto pt-8 border-t border-outline-variant space-y-2">
          <a className="flex items-center gap-4 p-2 text-on-surface-variant hover:bg-surface-container-high transition-all rounded-lg" href="#">
            <span className="material-symbols-outlined font-light">settings</span>
            Settings
          </a>
          <a className="flex items-center gap-4 p-2 text-on-surface-variant hover:bg-surface-container-high transition-all rounded-lg" href="#">
            <span className="material-symbols-outlined font-light">help</span>
            Support
          </a>
        </div>
      </aside>

      {/* Main Content Canvas */}
      <main className="flex-1 md:ml-64 pt-16 bg-background min-h-screen px-8 py-6">
        {children}
      </main>
    </div>
  );
}

<file path="frontend-ui/src/components/ui/button.tsx">
import { Button as ButtonPrimitive } from "@base-ui/react/button"
import { cva, type VariantProps } from "class-variance-authority"

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"

const buttonVariants = cva(
  "group/button inline-flex shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-lg border border-transparent bg-clip-padding text-sm font-medium whitespace-nowrap transition-all outline-none select-none focus-visible:border-ring focus-visible:ring-3 focus-visible:ring-ring/50 active:not-aria-[haspopup]:translate-y-px disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-50 aria-invalid:border-destructive aria-invalid:ring-3 aria-invalid:ring-destructive/20 dark:aria-invalid:border-destructive/50 dark:aria-invalid:ring-destructive/40 [&_svg]:pointer-events-none [&_svg]:shrink-0 [&_svg:not([class*='size-'])]:size-4",
  {
    variants: {
      variant: {
        default: "bg-primary text-primary-foreground hover:bg-primary/80",
        outline:
          "border-border bg-background hover:bg-muted hover:text-foreground aria-expanded:bg-muted aria-expanded:text-foreground dark:border-input dark:bg-input/30 dark:hover:bg-input/50",
        secondary:
          "bg-secondary text-secondary-foreground hover:bg-[color-mix(in_oklch,var(--secondary),var(--foreground)_5%)] aria-expanded:bg-secondary aria-expanded:text-secondary-foreground",
        ghost:
          "hover:bg-muted hover:text-foreground aria-expanded:bg-muted aria-expanded:text-foreground dark:hover:bg-muted/50",
        destructive:
          "bg-destructive/10 text-destructive hover:bg-destructive/20 focus-visible:border-destructive/40 focus-visible:ring-destructive/20 dark:bg-destructive/20 dark:hover:bg-destructive/30 dark:focus-visible:ring-destructive/40",
        link: "text-primary underline-offset-4 hover:underline",
      },
      size: {
        default:
          "h-8 gap-1.5 px-2.5 has-data-[icon=inline-end]:pr-2 has-data-[icon=inline-start]:pl-2",
        xs: "h-6 gap-1 rounded-[min(var(--radius-md),10px)] px-2 text-xs in-data-[slot=button-group]:rounded-lg has-data-[icon=inline-end]:pr-1.5 has-data-[icon=inline-start]:pl-1.5 [&_svg:not([class*='size-'])]:size-3",
        sm: "h-7 gap-1 rounded-[min(var(--radius-md),12px)] px-2.5 text-[0.8rem] in-data-[slot=button-group]:rounded-lg has-data-[icon=inline-end]:pr-1.5 has-data-[icon=inline-start]:pl-1.5 [&_svg:not([class*='size-'])]:size-3.5",
        lg: "h-9 gap-1.5 px-2.5 has-data-[icon=inline-end]:pr-2 has-data-[icon=inline-start]:pl-2",
        icon: "size-8",
        "icon-xs":
          "size-6 rounded-[min(var(--radius-md),10px)] in-data-[slot=button-group]:rounded-lg [&_svg:not([class*='size-'])]:size-3",
        "icon-sm":
          "size-7 rounded-[min(var(--radius-md),12px)] in-data-[slot=button-group]:rounded-lg",
        "icon-lg": "size-9",
      },
    },
    defaultVariants: {
      variant: "default",
      size: "default",
    },
  }
)

function Button({
  className,
  variant = "default",
  size = "default",
  ...props
}: ButtonPrimitive.Props & VariantProps<typeof buttonVariants>) {
  return (
    <ButtonPrimitive
      data-slot="button"
      className={cn(buttonVariants({ variant, size, className }))}
      {...props}
    />
  )
}

export { Button, buttonVariants }
</file>

<file path="frontend-ui/src/components/ui/card.tsx">
import * as React from "react"

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"

function Card({
  className,
  size = "default",
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<"div"> & { size?: "default" | "sm" }) {
  return (
    <div
      data-slot="card"
      data-size={size}
      className={cn(
        "group/card flex flex-col gap-(--card-spacing) overflow-hidden rounded-xl bg-card py-(--card-spacing) text-sm text-card-foreground ring-1 ring-foreground/10 [--card-spacing:--spacing(4)] has-data-[slot=card-footer]:pb-0 has-[>img:first-child]:pt-0 data-[size=sm]:[--card-spacing:--spacing(3)] data-[size=sm]:has-data-[slot=card-footer]:pb-0 *:[img:first-child]:rounded-t-xl *:[img:last-child]:rounded-b-xl",
        className
      )}
      {...props}
    />
  )
}

function CardHeader({ className, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<"div">) {
  return (
    <div
      data-slot="card-header"
      className={cn(
        "group/card-header @container/card-header grid auto-rows-min items-start gap-1 rounded-t-xl px-(--card-spacing) has-data-[slot=card-action]:grid-cols-[1fr_auto] has-data-[slot=card-description]:grid-rows-[auto_auto] [.border-b]:pb-(--card-spacing)",
        className
      )}
      {...props}
    />
  )
}

function CardTitle({ className, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<"div">) {
  return (
    <div
      data-slot="card-title"
      className={cn(
        "font-heading text-base leading-snug font-medium group-data-[size=sm]/card:text-sm",
        className
      )}
      {...props}
    />
  )
}

function CardDescription({ className, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<"div">) {
  return (
    <div
      data-slot="card-description"
      className={cn("text-sm text-muted-foreground", className)}
      {...props}
    />
  )
}

function CardAction({ className, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<"div">) {
  return (
    <div
      data-slot="card-action"
      className={cn(
        "col-start-2 row-span-2 row-start-1 self-start justify-self-end",
        className
      )}
      {...props}
    />
  )
}

function CardContent({ className, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<"div">) {
  return (
    <div
      data-slot="card-content"
      className={cn("px-(--card-spacing)", className)}
      {...props}
    />
  )
}

function CardFooter({ className, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<"div">) {
  return (
    <div
      data-slot="card-footer"
      className={cn(
        "flex items-center rounded-b-xl border-t bg-muted/50 p-(--card-spacing)",
        className
      )}
      {...props}
    />
  )
}

export {
  Card,
  CardHeader,
  CardFooter,
  CardTitle,
  CardAction,
  CardDescription,
  CardContent,
}

<file path="frontend-ui/src/components/ui/select.tsx">
import * as React from "react"
import { Select as SelectPrimitive } from "@base-ui/react/select"

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"
import { ChevronDownIcon, CheckIcon, ChevronUpIcon } from "lucide-react"

const Select = SelectPrimitive.Root

function SelectGroup({ className, ...props }: SelectPrimitive.Group.Props) {
  return (
    <SelectPrimitive.Group
      data-slot="select-group"
      className={cn("scroll-my-1 p-1", className)}
      {...props}
    />
  )
}

function SelectValue({ className, ...props }: SelectPrimitive.Value.Props) {
  return (
    <SelectPrimitive.Value
      data-slot="select-value"
      className={cn("flex flex-1 text-left", className)}
      {...props}
    />
  )
}

function SelectTrigger({
  className,
  size = "default",
  children,
  ...props
}: SelectPrimitive.Trigger.Props & {
  size?: "sm" | "default"
}) {
  return (
    <SelectPrimitive.Trigger
      data-slot="select-trigger"
      data-size={size}
      className={cn(
        "flex w-fit items-center justify-between gap-1.5 rounded-lg border border-input bg-transparent py-2 pr-2 pl-2.5 text-sm whitespace-nowrap transition-colors outline-none select-none focus-visible:border-ring focus-visible:ring-3 focus-visible:ring-ring/50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50 aria-invalid:border-destructive aria-invalid:ring-3 aria-invalid:ring-destructive/20 data-placeholder:text-muted-foreground data-[size=default]:h-8 data-[size=sm]:h-7 data-[size=sm]:rounded-[min(var(--radius-md),10px)] *:data-[slot=select-value]:line-clamp-1 *:data-[slot=select-value]:flex *:data-[slot=select-value]:items-center *:data-[slot=select-value]:gap-1.5 dark:bg-input/30 dark:hover:bg-input/50 dark:aria-invalid:border-destructive/50 dark:aria-invalid:ring-destructive/40 [&_svg]:pointer-events-none [&_svg]:shrink-0 [&_svg:not([class*='size-'])]:size-4",
        className
      )}
      {...props}
    >
      {children}
      <SelectPrimitive.Icon
        render={
          <ChevronDownIcon className="pointer-events-none size-4 text-muted-foreground" />
        }
      />
    </SelectPrimitive.Trigger>
  )
}

function SelectContent({
  className,
  children,
  side = "bottom",
  sideOffset = 4,
  align = "center",
  alignOffset = 0,
  alignItemWithTrigger = true,
  ...props
}: SelectPrimitive.Popup.Props &
  Pick<
    SelectPrimitive.Positioner.Props,
    "align" | "alignOffset" | "side" | "sideOffset" | "alignItemWithTrigger"
  >) {
  return (
    <SelectPrimitive.Portal>
      <SelectPrimitive.Positioner
        side={side}
        sideOffset={sideOffset}
        align={align}
        alignOffset={alignOffset}
        alignItemWithTrigger={alignItemWithTrigger}
        className="isolate z-50"
      >
        <SelectPrimitive.Popup
          data-slot="select-content"
          data-align-trigger={alignItemWithTrigger}
          className={cn("relative isolate z-50 max-h-(--available-height) w-(--anchor-width) min-w-36 origin-(--transform-origin) overflow-x-hidden overflow-y-auto rounded-lg bg-popover text-popover-foreground shadow-md ring-1 ring-foreground/10 duration-100 data-[align-trigger=true]:animate-none data-[side=bottom]:slide-in-from-top-2 data-[side=inline-end]:slide-in-from-left-2 data-[side=inline-start]:slide-in-from-right-2 data-[side=left]:slide-in-from-right-2 data-[side=right]:slide-in-from-left-2 data-[side=top]:slide-in-from-bottom-2 data-open:animate-in data-open:fade-in-0 data-open:zoom-in-95 data-closed:animate-out data-closed:fade-out-0 data-closed:zoom-out-95", className )}
          {...props}
        >
          <SelectScrollUpButton />
          <SelectPrimitive.List>{children}</SelectPrimitive.List>
          <SelectScrollDownButton />
        </SelectPrimitive.Popup>
      </SelectPrimitive.Positioner>
    </SelectPrimitive.Portal>
  )
}

function SelectLabel({
  className,
  ...props
}: SelectPrimitive.GroupLabel.Props) {
  return (
    <SelectPrimitive.GroupLabel
      data-slot="select-label"
      className={cn("px-1.5 py-1 text-xs text-muted-foreground", className)}
      {...props}
    />
  )
}

function SelectItem({
  className,
  children,
  ...props
}: SelectPrimitive.Item.Props) {
  return (
    <SelectPrimitive.Item
      data-slot="select-item"
      className={cn(
        "relative flex w-full cursor-default items-center gap-1.5 rounded-md py-1 pr-8 pl-1.5 text-sm outline-hidden select-none focus:bg-accent focus:text-accent-foreground not-data-[variant=destructive]:focus:**:text-accent-foreground data-disabled:pointer-events-none data-disabled:opacity-50 [&_svg]:pointer-events-none [&_svg]:shrink-0 [&_svg:not([class*='size-'])]:size-4 *:[span]:last:flex *:[span]:last:items-center *:[span]:last:gap-2",
        className
      )}
      {...props}
    >
      <SelectPrimitive.ItemText className="flex flex-1 shrink-0 gap-2 whitespace-nowrap">
        {children}
      </SelectPrimitive.ItemText>
      <SelectPrimitive.ItemIndicator
        render={
          <span className="pointer-events-none absolute right-2 flex size-4 items-center justify-center" />
        }
      >
        <CheckIcon className="pointer-events-none" />
      </SelectPrimitive.ItemIndicator>
    </SelectPrimitive.Item>
  )
}

function SelectSeparator({
  className,
  ...props
}: SelectPrimitive.Separator.Props) {
  return (
    <SelectPrimitive.Separator
      data-slot="select-separator"
      className={cn("pointer-events-none -mx-1 my-1 h-px bg-border", className)}
      {...props}
    />
  )
}

function SelectScrollUpButton({
  className,
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<typeof SelectPrimitive.ScrollUpArrow>) {
  return (
    <SelectPrimitive.ScrollUpArrow
      data-slot="select-scroll-up-button"
      className={cn(
        "top-0 z-10 flex w-full cursor-default items-center justify-center bg-popover py-1 [&_svg:not([class*='size-'])]:size-4",
        className
      )}
      {...props}
    >
      <ChevronUpIcon
      />
    </SelectPrimitive.ScrollUpArrow>
  )
}

function SelectScrollDownButton({
  className,
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<typeof SelectPrimitive.ScrollDownArrow>) {
  return (
    <SelectPrimitive.ScrollDownArrow
      data-slot="select-scroll-down-button"
      className={cn(
        "bottom-0 z-10 flex w-full cursor-default items-center justify-center bg-popover py-1 [&_svg:not([class*='size-'])]:size-4",
        className
      )}
      {...props}
    >
      <ChevronDownIcon
      />
    </SelectPrimitive.ScrollDownArrow>
  )
}

export {
  Select,
  SelectContent,
  SelectGroup,
  SelectItem,
  SelectLabel,
  SelectScrollDownButton,
  SelectScrollUpButton,
  SelectSeparator,
  SelectTrigger,
  SelectValue,
}

import  { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import {
  ScatterChart,
  Scatter,
  XAxis,
  YAxis,
  ZAxis,
  CartesianGrid,
  Tooltip as RechartsTooltip,
  ResponsiveContainer,
  BarChart,
  Bar,
} from 'recharts';
import { Loader2, AlertCircle } from 'lucide-react';

interface FitAuthenticityMap {
  username: string;
  platform: string;
  x_authenticity: number;
  y_composite_fit: number;
  z_reach: number;
}

interface CPERanking {
  username: string;
  platform: string;
  cpe: number;
  followers: number;
}

interface HistoryLog {
  match_id: string;
  username: string;
  platform: string;
  rank: number;
  composite_score: number;
  authenticity_score: number;
  semantic_score: number;
  cpe: number;
  created_at: string;
}

interface AnalyticsPayload {
  campaign_id: string;
  fit_authenticity_map: FitAuthenticityMap[];
  cpe_ranking: CPERanking[];
  history_logs: HistoryLog[];
}

export function CampaignAnalytics({ campaignId }: { campaignId: string }) {
  const [data, setData] = useState<AnalyticsPayload | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState<boolean>(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    async function fetchAnalytics() {
      setLoading(true);
      setError(null);
      try {
        const response = await fetch(`http://localhost:8000/campaigns/${campaignId}/analytics`, {
          credentials: 'include',
        });
        if (!response.ok) {
          throw new Error('Failed to fetch analytics data.');
        }
        const jsonData = await response.json();
        setData(jsonData);
      } catch (err: any) {
        setError(err.message || 'An unknown error occurred.');
      } finally {
        setLoading(false);
      }
    }
    
    if (campaignId) {
      fetchAnalytics();
    }
  }, [campaignId]);

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div className="flex h-64 items-center justify-center border border-slate-200 bg-surface rounded-none">
        <Loader2 className="h-8 w-8 animate-spin text-slate-800" />
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (error) {
    return (
      <div className="flex h-64 flex-col items-center justify-center border border-slate-200 bg-red-50 text-red-700 rounded-none p-6 text-center">
        <AlertCircle className="h-8 w-8 mb-2" />
        <h3 className="text-lg font-semibold font-sans">Analytics Unavailable</h3>
        <p className="text-sm font-mono mt-2">{error}</p>
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (!data) {
    return (
      <div className="flex h-64 items-center justify-center border border-slate-200 bg-surface text-slate-500 rounded-none">
        No analytics data found for this campaign.
      </div>
    );
  }

  const formatPercent = (val: number) => `${(val * 100).toFixed(0)}%`;
  const formatCurrency = (val: number) => `$${val.toFixed(2)}`;

  const ScatterTooltip = ({ active, payload }: any) => {
    if (active && payload && payload.length) {
      const data = payload[0].payload;
      return (
        <div className="bg-white border border-slate-800 p-3 shadow-sm rounded-none">
          <p className="font-semibold text-slate-800 text-sm mb-1">@{data.username}</p>
          <p className="text-xs text-slate-600 font-mono mb-2 uppercase">{data.platform}</p>
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-1">
            <div className="flex justify-between text-xs">
              <span className="text-slate-500 mr-4">Authenticity:</span>
              <span className="font-mono text-slate-800 font-medium">{formatPercent(data.x_authenticity)}</span>
            </div>
            <div className="flex justify-between text-xs">
              <span className="text-slate-500 mr-4">Fit:</span>
              <span className="font-mono text-slate-800 font-medium">{formatPercent(data.y_composite_fit)}</span>
            </div>
            <div className="flex justify-between text-xs">
              <span className="text-slate-500 mr-4">Reach:</span>
              <span className="font-mono text-slate-800 font-medium">{data.z_reach.toLocaleString()}</span>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      );
    }
    return null;
  };

  const BarTooltip = ({ active, payload }: any) => {
    if (active && payload && payload.length) {
      const data = payload[0].payload;
      return (
        <div className="bg-white border border-slate-800 p-3 shadow-sm rounded-none">
          <p className="font-semibold text-slate-800 text-sm mb-1">@{data.username}</p>
          <div className="flex justify-between text-xs mt-2">
            <span className="text-slate-500 mr-4">CPE:</span>
            <span className="font-mono text-slate-800 font-medium">{formatCurrency(data.cpe)}</span>
          </div>
        </div>
      );
    }
    return null;
  };

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-8">
      {/* Charts Row */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-6">
        
        {/* Chart 1: Fit × Authenticity Scatter/Bubble Map */}
        <div className="border border-slate-200 bg-white p-6 rounded-none flex flex-col">
          <h3 className="text-lg text-slate-800 font-semibold mb-1">Fit × Authenticity Matrix</h3>
          <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 mb-6 uppercase tracking-wider">Reach visualized by bubble radius</p>
          <div className="h-72 w-full mt-auto">
            <ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height="100%">
              <ScatterChart margin={{ top: 10, right: 20, bottom: 20, left: 0 }}>
                <CartesianGrid strokeDasharray="3 3" vertical={false} stroke="#e2e8f0" />
                <XAxis 
                  type="number" 
                  dataKey="x_authenticity" 
                  name="Authenticity" 
                  domain={[0, 1]} 
                  tickFormatter={formatPercent}
                  tick={{ fontSize: 11, fill: '#64748b', fontFamily: 'monospace' }}
                  axisLine={{ stroke: '#cbd5e1' }}
                  tickLine={false}
                  dy={10}
                />
                <YAxis 
                  type="number" 
                  dataKey="y_composite_fit" 
                  name="Composite Fit" 
                  domain={[0, 1]} 
                  tickFormatter={formatPercent}
                  tick={{ fontSize: 11, fill: '#64748b', fontFamily: 'monospace' }}
                  axisLine={{ stroke: '#cbd5e1' }}
                  tickLine={false}
                  dx={-10}
                />
                <ZAxis 
                  type="number" 
                  dataKey="z_reach" 
                  range={[20, 400]} 
                  name="Reach" 
                />
                <RechartsTooltip cursor={{ strokeDasharray: '3 3' }} content={<ScatterTooltip />} />
                <Scatter data={data.fit_authenticity_map} fill="#1e293b" opacity={0.7} />
              </ScatterChart>
            </ResponsiveContainer>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Chart 2: Cost Per Engagement Bar Graph */}
        <div className="border border-slate-200 bg-white p-6 rounded-none flex flex-col">
          <h3 className="text-lg text-slate-800 font-semibold mb-1">Cost Per Engagement (CPE)</h3>
          <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 mb-6 uppercase tracking-wider">Ranked lowest to highest</p>
          <div className="h-72 w-full mt-auto">
            <ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height="100%">
              <BarChart data={data.cpe_ranking} margin={{ top: 10, right: 0, bottom: 20, left: 0 }}>
                <CartesianGrid strokeDasharray="3 3" vertical={false} stroke="#e2e8f0" />
                <XAxis 
                  dataKey="username" 
                  tick={{ fontSize: 11, fill: '#64748b', fontFamily: 'monospace' }}
                  axisLine={{ stroke: '#cbd5e1' }}
                  tickLine={false}
                  dy={10}
                />
                <YAxis 
                  tickFormatter={formatCurrency}
                  tick={{ fontSize: 11, fill: '#64748b', fontFamily: 'monospace' }}
                  axisLine={{ stroke: '#cbd5e1' }}
                  tickLine={false}
                  dx={-10}
                />
                <RechartsTooltip cursor={{ fill: '#f1f5f9' }} content={<BarTooltip />} />
                <Bar dataKey="cpe" fill="#1e293b" radius={0} maxBarSize={48} />
              </BarChart>
            </ResponsiveContainer>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Tracking Memory Audit Log (Table) */}
      <div className="border border-slate-200 bg-white rounded-none flex flex-col overflow-hidden">
        <div className="p-5 border-b border-slate-200 bg-slate-50">
          <h3 className="text-lg text-slate-800 font-semibold mb-1">Match Audit Log</h3>
          <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-wider">Historical performance tracking</p>
        </div>
        <div className="overflow-x-auto">
          <table className="w-full text-left border-collapse">
            <thead>
              <tr className="border-b border-slate-200">
                <th className="py-3 px-4 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-600 uppercase tracking-wider bg-white">Rank</th>
                <th className="py-3 px-4 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-600 uppercase tracking-wider bg-white">Creator</th>
                <th className="py-3 px-4 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-600 uppercase tracking-wider bg-white">Platform</th>
                <th className="py-3 px-4 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-600 uppercase tracking-wider bg-white text-right">Composite Fit</th>
                <th className="py-3 px-4 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-600 uppercase tracking-wider bg-white text-right">Authenticity</th>
                <th className="py-3 px-4 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-600 uppercase tracking-wider bg-white text-right">Semantic Dist.</th>
                <th className="py-3 px-4 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-600 uppercase tracking-wider bg-white text-right">CPE</th>
                <th className="py-3 px-4 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-600 uppercase tracking-wider bg-white text-right">Run Timestamp</th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-100">
              {data.history_logs.map((log) => (
                <tr key={log.match_id} className="hover:bg-slate-50 transition-colors">
                  <td className="py-3 px-4">
                    <span className="inline-flex items-center justify-center w-6 h-6 rounded-none bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 font-mono text-xs font-medium border border-slate-200">
                      {log.rank}
                    </span>
                  </td>
                  <td className="py-3 px-4 font-medium text-slate-800 text-sm">@{log.username}</td>
                  <td className="py-3 px-4 text-sm text-slate-500 capitalize">{log.platform}</td>
                  <td className="py-3 px-4 text-right font-mono text-sm text-slate-800">{formatPercent(log.composite_score)}</td>
                  <td className="py-3 px-4 text-right font-mono text-sm text-slate-800">{formatPercent(log.authenticity_score)}</td>
                  <td className="py-3 px-4 text-right font-mono text-sm text-slate-800">{log.semantic_score !== null && log.semantic_score !== undefined ? log.semantic_score.toFixed(3) : '-'}</td>
                  <td className="py-3 px-4 text-right font-mono text-sm text-slate-800">{log.cpe !== null && log.cpe !== undefined ? formatCurrency(log.cpe) : '-'}</td>
                  <td className="py-3 px-4 text-right font-mono text-xs text-slate-500">
                    {new Date(log.created_at).toLocaleString(undefined, { 
                      year: 'numeric', 
                      month: 'short', 
                      day: 'numeric',
                      hour: '2-digit',
                      minute: '2-digit'
                    })}
                  </td>
                </tr>
              ))}
              {data.history_logs.length === 0 && (
                <tr>
                  <td colSpan={8} className="py-8 text-center text-slate-500 text-sm">
                    No historical logs available for this campaign.
                  </td>
                </tr>
              )}
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
</file>

<file path="frontend-ui/src/components/MatchResults.tsx">
import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { useSearchParams } from 'react-router-dom';
import { CampaignAnalytics } from './CampaignAnalytics';

export function MatchResults() {
  const [searchParams] = useSearchParams();
  const campaignId = searchParams.get('campaign_id');
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [results, setResults] = useState<any[]>([]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (campaignId) {
      fetchMatches();
    }
  }, [campaignId]);

  const fetchMatches = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const response = await fetch('/match', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        credentials: 'include',
        body: JSON.stringify({ campaign_id: campaignId, num_results: 5 })
      });
      const data = await response.json();
      setResults(data.results || []);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("Failed to fetch matches", err);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const topMatches = results.slice(0, 2);
  const hasComparison = topMatches.length >= 2;

  return (
    <div className="px-8 py-6 max-w-container-max mx-auto h-full space-y-8">
      {/* Header Section */}
      <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row justify-between items-start md:items-end gap-4">
        <div>
          <h2 className="font-display-lg text-display-lg text-on-surface mb-2">Match Results &amp; Analytics</h2>
          <p className="font-body-lg text-body-lg text-on-surface-variant">AI-vetted creators and historical campaign intelligence.</p>
        </div>
        <div className="flex bg-surface-container-low p-1 rounded-lg border border-outline-variant mr-md">
          <button className="px-md py-1 rounded-md bg-surface-container-lowest text-primary-container font-bold text-label-md shadow-sm">Dashboard View</button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {loading ? (
        <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center py-24 text-on-surface-variant">
          <span className="material-symbols-outlined text-primary-container animate-spin text-4xl mb-4">progress_activity</span>
          <p className="font-headline-sm text-headline-sm text-on-surface animate-pulse">Running Semantic Search &amp; Aggregating Metrics...</p>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <>
          {/* Live Session Match Results Grid */}
          {results.length > 0 ? (
            <div className="space-y-8">
              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
                {results.map((candidate, idx) => (
                  <div key={idx} className="bg-white rounded-xl shadow-sm border border-slate-200 p-6 flex flex-col">
                    <div className="flex justify-between items-start mb-4">
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                        <div className="w-12 h-12 rounded-full bg-slate-900 text-white flex items-center justify-center text-lg font-bold">
                          {candidate.influencer.username.charAt(0).toUpperCase()}
                        </div>
                        <div>
                          <h3 className="font-bold text-slate-900">@{candidate.influencer.username}</h3>
                          <span className="text-xs text-slate-500 capitalize">{candidate.influencer.platform}</span>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                      <div className="bg-emerald-50 border border-emerald-200 text-emerald-700 px-3 py-1 rounded-lg font-mono font-bold text-sm">
                        {(candidate.scores.composite_fit * 100).toFixed(0)}% Fit
                      </div>
                    </div>
                    
                    <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2 my-4 py-3 border-t border-b border-slate-100 text-center font-mono text-xs">
                      <div>
                        <span className="block text-slate-400">Followers</span>
                        <span className="font-bold text-slate-800">
                          {candidate.influencer.followers >= 1000000 
                            ? (candidate.influencer.followers / 1000000).toFixed(1) + 'M' 
                            : (candidate.influencer.followers / 1000).toFixed(1) + 'K'}
                        </span>
                      </div>
                      <div className="border-l border-slate-100">
                        <span className="block text-slate-400">Authentic</span>
                        <span className="font-bold text-emerald-600">{(candidate.scores.authenticity * 100).toFixed(0)}%</span>
                      </div>
                      <div className="border-l border-slate-100">
                        <span className="block text-slate-400">Est. CPE</span>
                        <span className="font-bold text-slate-800">${candidate.financials.cpe.toFixed(2)}</span>
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    <p className="text-xs text-slate-600 italic mt-auto bg-slate-50 p-3 rounded border border-slate-100">
                      &ldquo;{candidate.explanation}&rdquo;
                    </p>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>

              {/* Comparative Intelligence Benchmarking */}
              {hasComparison && (
                <section className="bg-white border border-slate-200 p-6 rounded-xl shadow-sm">
                  <h3 className="text-lg font-bold text-slate-900 mb-1">Comparative Intelligence Benchmark</h3>
                  <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 mb-4">Side-by-side performance review of top candidates.</p>
                  <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4 font-mono text-sm">
                    <div className="p-4 bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200">
                      <span className="font-bold text-slate-800">#{1} @{topMatches[0].influencer.username}</span>
                      <div className="text-xs text-slate-600 mt-2 space-y-1">
                        <div>Authenticity: {(topMatches[0].scores.authenticity * 100).toFixed(1)}%</div>
                        <div>CPE: ${topMatches[0].financials.cpe.toFixed(2)}</div>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                    <div className="p-4 bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200">
                      <span className="font-bold text-slate-800">#{2} @{topMatches[1].influencer.username}</span>
                      <div className="text-xs text-slate-600 mt-2 space-y-1">
                        <div>Authenticity: {(topMatches[1].scores.authenticity * 100).toFixed(1)}%</div>
                        <div>CPE: ${topMatches[1].financials.cpe.toFixed(2)}</div>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </section>
              )}
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div className="bg-white border border-slate-200 p-8 rounded-xl text-center">
              <p className="text-slate-600 font-medium">No live match session found for this campaign ID.</p>
              <p className="text-xs text-slate-400 mt-1">Review your historical tracking metrics and audit logs below.</p>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Persistent Campaign Analytics & Workspace Tracking Memory */}
          {campaignId && (
            <div className="mt-12 pt-8 border-t border-slate-200">
              <div className="mb-6">
                <h3 className="text-xl font-bold text-slate-900">Workspace Analytics &amp; Tracking Memory</h3>
                <p className="text-sm text-slate-500">Multidimensional evaluation maps and audit logs pulled directly from historical database runs.</p>
              </div>
              <CampaignAnalytics campaignId={campaignId} />
            </div>
          )}
        </>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
</file>

<file path="frontend-ui/src/lib/utils.ts">
import { clsx, type ClassValue } from "clsx"
import { twMerge } from "tailwind-merge"

export function cn(...inputs: ClassValue[]) {
  return twMerge(clsx(inputs))
}
</file>

<file path="frontend-ui/src/pages/AuthPage.tsx">
import { useState } from 'react';
import { fetchApi } from '../services/api';

interface AuthPageProps {
  onLogin: () => void;
}

export default function AuthPage({ onLogin }: AuthPageProps) {
  const [isLogin, setIsLogin] = useState(true);
  const [email, setEmail] = useState('');
  const [password, setPassword] = useState('');
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [showPassword, setShowPassword] = useState(false);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setError('');
    setLoading(true);

    try {
      if (isLogin) {
        await fetchApi('/auth/login', {
          method: 'POST',
          body: JSON.stringify({ email, password, recaptcha_token: 'dev_bypass' }),
        });
      } else {
        await fetchApi('/auth/register', {
          method: 'POST',
          body: JSON.stringify({ email, password, recaptcha_token: 'dev_bypass' }),
        });
      }
      onLogin();
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(err.message || 'Authentication failed');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="flex h-screen w-full bg-surface-container-lowest overflow-hidden">
      {/* Left Side: Interactive Graphic / Branding */}
      <div className="hidden lg:flex lg:w-1/2 relative bg-surface-container-lowest geometric-bg border-r border-outline-variant flex-col justify-between p-10">
        <div className="z-10">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <span className="font-headline-md text-headline-md text-primary font-bold">MatchInfluence AI</span>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="z-10 max-w-md">
          <span className="material-symbols-outlined text-primary text-4xl mb-4" style={{ fontVariationSettings: "'FILL' 1" }}>insights</span>
          <h1 className="font-headline-lg text-headline-lg text-on-surface mb-4">Executive Intelligence.</h1>
          <p className="font-body-lg text-body-lg text-on-surface-variant">
            Unlock high-performance influencer marketing campaigns driven by sophisticated data modeling and predictive analytics. Connect with the right voices instantly.
          </p>
        </div>
        <div className="z-10 flex items-center gap-4 text-on-surface-variant">
          <span className="material-symbols-outlined" style={{ fontVariationSettings: "'FILL' 1" }}>verified_user</span>
          <span className="font-label-sm text-label-sm uppercase tracking-wider">Enterprise Grade Security</span>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Right Side: Authentication Form */}
      <div className="w-full lg:w-1/2 flex flex-col justify-center items-center px-8 py-6 bg-surface-container-lowest relative overflow-y-auto">
        {/* Mobile Logo */}
        <div className="lg:hidden absolute top-6 left-6 flex items-center gap-2 mb-10">
          <span className="font-headline-md text-headline-md text-primary font-bold">MatchInfluence AI</span>
        </div>

        <div className="w-full max-w-sm">
          {/* Form Header */}
          <div className="mb-6 text-center lg:mb-10">
            <h2 className="font-headline-lg text-headline-lg text-on-surface mb-1 hidden md:block">
              {isLogin ? 'Welcome Back' : 'Create an Account'}
            </h2>
            <h2 className="font-headline-lg-mobile text-headline-lg-mobile text-on-surface mb-1 md:hidden">
              {isLogin ? 'Welcome Back' : 'Create an Account'}
            </h2>
            <p className="font-body-md text-body-md text-on-surface-variant">
              {isLogin ? 'Sign in to access your intelligence dashboard.' : 'Join MatchInfluence AI to start optimizing.'}
            </p>
          </div>

          {/* Toggle Container */}
          <div className="flex p-1 rounded-lg mb-6 lg:mb-10 bg-surface-container-low">
            <button
              className={`flex-1 py-2 font-label-sm text-label-sm rounded transition-colors ${isLogin ? 'bg-surface-container-lowest text-on-surface shadow-sm' : 'text-on-surface-variant hover:text-on-surface'}`}
              onClick={() => setIsLogin(true)}
              type="button"
            >
              Sign In
            </button>
            <button
              className={`flex-1 py-2 font-label-sm text-label-sm rounded transition-colors ${!isLogin ? 'bg-surface-container-lowest text-on-surface shadow-sm' : 'text-on-surface-variant hover:text-on-surface'}`}
              onClick={() => setIsLogin(false)}
              type="button"
            >
              Create Account
            </button>
          </div>

          {/* Error/Success Message Container */}
          {error && (
            <div className="mb-4 p-4 bg-error-container border border-error/20 rounded-lg flex items-start gap-2">
              <span className="material-symbols-outlined text-error mt-0.5 text-sm" style={{ fontVariationSettings: "'FILL' 1" }}>error</span>
              <div>
                <h3 className="font-label-sm text-label-sm text-on-error-container">Authentication Failed</h3>
                <p className="font-body-md text-body-md text-on-error-container/80 text-sm mt-1">{error}</p>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Form */}
          <form className="space-y-4" onSubmit={handleSubmit}>
            {/* Email Field */}
            <div>
              <label className="block font-label-sm text-label-sm text-on-surface mb-1" htmlFor="email">Email Address</label>
              <div className="relative">
                <div className="absolute inset-y-0 left-0 pl-3 flex items-center pointer-events-none">
                  <span className="material-symbols-outlined text-on-surface-variant text-sm">mail</span>
                </div>
                <input
                  className="w-full pl-10 pr-3 py-2 bg-surface-container-lowest border border-outline-variant rounded-lg font-body-md text-body-md text-on-surface placeholder:text-on-surface-variant focus:border-primary focus:ring-0 input-glow transition-all"
                  id="email"
                  type="email"
                  value={email}
                  onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="name@company.com"
                  required
                />
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Password Field */}
            <div>
              <div className="flex justify-between items-center mb-1">
                <label className="block font-label-sm text-label-sm text-on-surface" htmlFor="password">Password</label>
                {isLogin && <a className="font-label-sm text-label-sm text-primary hover:text-primary-container transition-colors" href="#">Forgot password?</a>}
              </div>
              <div className="relative">
                <div className="absolute inset-y-0 left-0 pl-3 flex items-center pointer-events-none">
                  <span className="material-symbols-outlined text-on-surface-variant text-sm">lock</span>
                </div>
                <input
                  className="w-full pl-10 pr-10 py-2 bg-surface-container-lowest border border-outline-variant rounded-lg font-body-md text-body-md text-on-surface placeholder:text-on-surface-variant focus:border-primary focus:ring-0 input-glow transition-all"
                  id="password"
                  type={showPassword ? 'text' : 'password'}
                  value={password}
                  onChange={(e) => setPassword(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="••••••••"
                  required
                />
                <div
                  className="absolute inset-y-0 right-0 pr-3 flex items-center cursor-pointer text-on-surface-variant hover:text-on-surface transition-colors"
                  onClick={() => setShowPassword(!showPassword)}
                >
                  <span className="material-symbols-outlined text-sm">
                    {showPassword ? 'visibility_off' : 'visibility'}
                  </span>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Action Button */}
            <button
              disabled={loading}
              className="w-full py-2 hover:bg-primary/90 text-on-primary font-label-sm text-label-sm rounded-lg transition-colors flex justify-center items-center gap-2 bg-primary-container disabled:opacity-70"
              type="submit"
            >
              <span>{loading ? 'Processing...' : isLogin ? 'Sign In' : 'Create Account'}</span>
            </button>
          </form>

          <div className="mt-6 pt-6 border-t border-outline-variant/30 text-center">
            <p className="font-body-md text-body-md text-on-surface-variant text-sm">
              By {isLogin ? 'signing in' : 'creating an account'}, you agree to our <a className="text-primary hover:underline" href="#">Terms of Service</a> and <a className="text-primary hover:underline" href="#">Privacy Policy</a>.
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

import { useState } from 'react';
import { fetchApi } from '../services/api';

export default function CommandCenterPage() {
  const [magicPrompt, setMagicPrompt] = useState('');
  const [analysis, setAnalysis] = useState<any>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);

  const handleAnalyze = async () => {
    if (!magicPrompt) return;
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const data = await fetchApi('/campaigns/analyze', {
        method: 'POST',
        body: JSON.stringify({ magic_prompt: magicPrompt })
      });
      setAnalysis(data.analysis || data);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Failed to analyze', error);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const isReady = magicPrompt.length > 20;

  return (
    <div className="flex-1 px-8 py-6 h-full overflow-y-auto bg-surface relative">
      {/* Background Pattern */}
      <div className="absolute inset-0 pointer-events-none opacity-5" style={{ backgroundImage: "radial-gradient(#1e293b 1px, transparent 1px)", backgroundSize: "24px 24px" }}></div>

          <div>
            <h2 className="font-headline-lg text-headline-lg text-on-surface mb-2">Campaign Genesis</h2>
            <p className="font-body-lg text-body-lg text-on-surface-variant max-w-2xl">

            <div className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-primary-container pulse-live"></div>
            <span className="font-label-sm text-label-sm text-primary-container">Engine Active</span>
          </div>
        </header>

        <div className="flex-1 grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-gutter relative z-10 h-full pb-lg">

              <div className="p-4 border-b border-outline-variant bg-surface flex justify-between items-center">
                <span className="font-label-sm text-label-sm text-on-surface-variant flex items-center gap-2">
                  <span className="material-symbols-outlined text-sm font-light">edit_note</span> Brief Input
                </span>

                </button>
              </div>
              <textarea
                className="flex-1 w-full bg-transparent border-none p-gutter font-body-lg text-body-lg text-on-surface resize-none focus:ring-0 placeholder:text-outline"
                placeholder="We are launching a new line of ergonomic desk chairs designed for remote workers. We need influencers who..."
                value={magicPrompt}
                onChange={(e) => setMagicPrompt(e.target.value)}
              ></textarea>

              {/* Suggestion Pills */}
              <div className="p-4 bg-surface-container-low border-t border-outline-variant flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                <span className="font-label-sm text-label-sm text-on-surface-variant mr-2 self-center">Quick Add:</span>
                <button className="px-3 py-1.5 border border-outline-variant bg-surface-container-lowest text-on-surface font-label-sm text-label-sm hover:border-primary-container hover:text-primary-container transition-colors flex items-center gap-1 rounded">
                  <span className="material-symbols-outlined text-xs">add</span> Tech Reviews
                </button>
                <button className="px-3 py-1.5 border border-outline-variant bg-surface-container-lowest text-on-surface font-label-sm text-label-sm hover:border-primary-container hover:text-primary-container transition-colors flex items-center gap-1 rounded">
                  <span className="material-symbols-outlined text-xs">add</span> $5,000 Budget

                  <span className="material-symbols-outlined text-xs">add</span> US & Canada

                    {analysis?.niche || 'Waiting...'}
                  </span>
                </div>

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { fetchApi } from '../services/api';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';

export default function DashboardPage() {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [campaigns, setCampaigns] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [selectedCampaignId, setSelectedCampaignId] = useState('');
  const [isCreating, setIsCreating] = useState(false);

  // Form state
  const [niche, setNiche] = useState('');
  const [budget, setBudget] = useState('');

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchCampaigns();
  }, []);

  const fetchCampaigns = async () => {
    try {
      const data = await fetchApi('/campaigns');
      if (data && data.campaigns) setCampaigns(data.campaigns);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Failed to fetch campaigns', err);
    }
  };

  const handleCreateCampaign = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setIsCreating(true);
    try {
      await fetchApi('/campaigns', {
        method: 'POST',
        body: JSON.stringify({
          niche,
          budget: Number(budget)
        })
      });
      alert('Campaign saved successfully!');
      fetchCampaigns();
    } catch (err: any) {
      alert('Error: ' + err.message);
    } finally {
      setIsCreating(false);
    }
  };

  const handleRunMatch = () => {
    if (!selectedCampaignId) {
      alert('Please select a campaign first');
      return;
    }
    navigate(`/match-results?campaignId=${selectedCampaignId}`);
  };

  return (
    <div className="w-full max-w-4xl space-y-lg">
      {/* Page Header */}
      <div className="mb-lg">
        <h1 className="font-headline-lg text-4xl font-bold text-on-surface mb-sm">Shape a Brief</h1>
        <p className="font-body-lg text-lg text-on-surface-variant">Define your campaign parameters to initialize the AI matching sequence.</p>
      </div>

      {/* Bento Grid Layout for Form */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-gutter">

        {/* Primary Form Area (Spans 8 cols on desktop) */}
        <div className="md:col-span-8 space-y-lg">
          <div className="mi-card p-lg">
            <h2 className="font-headline-sm text-2xl text-on-surface mb-md pb-sm border-b border-outline-variant">Campaign Parameters</h2>

            <form className="space-y-md" onSubmit={handleCreateCampaign}>
              {/* Campaign Name */}
              <div>
                <label className="font-label-md text-label-md mi-label" htmlFor="campaign-name">Campaign Identifier</label>
                <input className="mi-input" id="campaign-name" placeholder="e.g., Q3 Tech Launch" type="text" />
              </div>

              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-md">
                {/* Niche */}
                <div>
                  <label className="font-label-md text-label-md mi-label" htmlFor="niche">Primary Niche</label>
                  <div className="relative">
                    <select
                      className="mi-input appearance-none pr-10"
                      id="niche"
                      value={niche}
                      onChange={(e) => setNiche(e.target.value)}
                      required
                    >
                      <option disabled value="">Select Niche...</option>
                      <option value="tech">Technology & Gadgets</option>
                      <option value="finance">FinTech & Crypto</option>
                      <option value="lifestyle">Executive Lifestyle</option>
                      <option value="b2b">B2B SaaS</option>
                      <option value="beauty">Beauty & Skincare</option>
                    </select>
                    <div className="pointer-events-none absolute inset-y-0 right-0 flex items-center px-3 text-on-surface-variant">
                      <span className="material-symbols-outlined text-sm">unfold_more</span>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* Target Audience */}
                <div>
                  <label className="font-label-md text-label-md mi-label" htmlFor="audience">Target Audience Demo</label>
                  <input className="mi-input" id="audience" placeholder="e.g., Males 25-45, Urban Professionals" type="text" />
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-md">
                {/* Budget */}
                <div>
                  <label className="font-label-md text-label-md mi-label" htmlFor="budget">Estimated Budget (USD)</label>
                  <div className="relative">
                    <div className="pointer-events-none absolute inset-y-0 left-0 flex items-center pl-3">
                      <span className="text-on-surface-variant font-body-md text-body-md">$</span>
                    </div>
                    <input
                      className="mi-input pl-8"
                      id="budget"
                      type="number"
                      min="0"
                      placeholder="50,000"
                      value={budget}
                      onChange={(e) => setBudget(e.target.value)}
                      required
                    />
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* Target Reach */}
                <div>
                  <label className="font-label-md text-label-md mi-label" htmlFor="reach">Target Reach (Minimum)</label>
                  <div className="relative">
                    <select className="mi-input appearance-none pr-10" id="reach">
                      <option value="100k">100k - 500k</option>
                      <option value="500k">500k - 1M</option>
                      <option value="1m">1M - 5M</option>
                      <option value="5m+">5M+</option>
                    </select>
                    <div className="pointer-events-none absolute inset-y-0 right-0 flex items-center px-3 text-on-surface-variant">
                      <span className="material-symbols-outlined text-sm">unfold_more</span>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Detailed Brief */}
              <div>
                <label className="font-label-md text-label-md mi-label" htmlFor="brief-details">Brief Context (Optional AI Input)</label>
                <textarea className="mi-input resize-none" id="brief-details" placeholder="Provide additional context for the AI matching algorithm..." rows={4}></textarea>
              </div>

              <div className="pt-sm flex justify-end mt-md">
                <button
                  disabled={isCreating}
                  className="mi-btn-primary font-button text-button px-lg py-sm disabled:opacity-50"
                  type="submit"
                >
                  <span className="material-symbols-outlined text-sm">bookmark</span>
                  {isCreating ? 'Saving...' : 'Save Campaign'}
                </button>
              </div>
            </form>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Secondary Section: Match Execution (Spans 4 cols on desktop) */}
        <div className="md:col-span-4 space-y-lg">
          <div className="mi-card p-lg bg-surface-container-low border-none relative overflow-hidden h-full flex flex-col">
            {/* Decorative minimal background element */}
            <div className="absolute -right-10 -top-10 w-40 h-40 bg-secondary/5 rounded-full blur-2xl pointer-events-none"></div>

            <div className="relative z-10 flex-1 flex flex-col">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-sm mb-md pb-sm border-b border-outline-variant/50">
                <span className="material-symbols-outlined text-secondary" style={{ fontVariationSettings: "'FILL' 1" }}>bolt</span>
                <h2 className="font-headline-sm text-xl text-on-surface">Execute Match</h2>
              </div>

              <p className="font-body-md text-sm text-on-surface-variant mb-md">
                Select a saved campaign brief to initialize the AI influencer matching sequence across the global database.
              </p>

              <div className="mt-auto space-y-md">
                <div>
                  <label className="font-label-md text-label-md mi-label" htmlFor="campaign-selector">Campaign Selector</label>
                  <div className="relative">
                    <select
                      className="mi-input bg-surface-container-lowest appearance-none pr-10"
                      id="campaign-selector"
                      value={selectedCampaignId}
                      onChange={(e) => setSelectedCampaignId(e.target.value)}
                    >
                      <option disabled value="">Select a saved brief...</option>
                      {campaigns.map(c => (
                        <option key={c.id} value={c.id}>{c.niche} - ${c.budget}</option>
                      ))}
                    </select>
                    <div className="pointer-events-none absolute inset-y-0 right-0 flex items-center px-3 text-on-surface-variant">
                      <span className="material-symbols-outlined text-sm">unfold_more</span>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>

                <button
                  onClick={handleRunMatch}
                  className="mi-btn-primary w-full justify-center bg-primary-container text-on-primary hover:bg-on-primary-fixed-variant py-md group relative overflow-hidden shadow-sm"
                  type="button"
                >
                  <span className="relative z-10 flex items-center gap-sm font-button text-button">
                    <span className="material-symbols-outlined group-hover:rotate-12 transition-transform duration-300">hub</span>
                    Run Match
                  </span>
                </button>

                <div className="text-center mt-sm">
                  <span className="text-[10px] text-on-surface-variant uppercase tracking-wider font-semibold">Phase 5 Sequence Ready</span>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* AI Status Indicator Mini Card */}
          <div className="mi-card p-md flex items-center justify-between bg-surface-container-lowest">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-sm">
              <div className="relative flex h-3 w-3">
                <span className="animate-ping absolute inline-flex h-full w-full rounded-full bg-secondary-container opacity-75"></span>
                <span className="relative inline-flex rounded-full h-3 w-3 bg-secondary"></span>
              </div>
              <span className="font-label-md text-sm font-medium text-on-surface">Data Engine Status</span>
            </div>
            <span className="font-mono text-xs text-secondary">Live</span>

<file path="frontend-ui/src/pages/MatchAnalysisPage.tsx">
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { useSearchParams } from 'react-router-dom';
import { fetchApi } from '../services/api';

export default function MatchAnalysisPage() {
  const [searchParams] = useSearchParams();
  const campaignId = searchParams.get('campaignId');
  const [results, setResults] = useState<any>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (campaignId) {
      fetchResults(campaignId);
    }
  }, [campaignId]);

  const fetchResults = async (id: string) => {
    try {
      const data = await fetchApi(`/match?campaign_id=${id}`);
      setResults(data.matches || data);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Failed to fetch match results', err);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="flex-1 px-8 py-6">
      {/* Header Section */}
      <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row justify-between items-start md:items-end mb-lg gap-4">
        <div>
          <h2 className="font-display-lg text-display-lg text-on-surface mb-2">Match Results</h2>
          <p className="font-body-lg text-body-lg text-on-surface-variant">Top AI-vetted creators for 'Q3 Urban Activewear' campaign.</p>
        </div>

<file path="frontend-ui/src/services/api.ts">
export const API_BASE_URL = 'http://localhost:8000';

export async function fetchApi(endpoint: string, options: RequestInit = {}) {
  const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE_URL}${endpoint}`, {
    ...options,
    headers: {
      'Content-Type': 'application/json',
      ...options.headers,
    },
    credentials: 'include',
  });

  if (!response.ok) {
    let errorMsg = 'An error occurred';
    try {
      const data = await response.json();
      errorMsg = data.detail || errorMsg;
    } catch (e) {
      // Ignored
    }
    throw new Error(errorMsg);
  }

  // Handle 204 No Content or empty responses
  if (response.status === 204 || response.headers.get('content-length') === '0') {
    return null;
  }
  
  return response.json();
}
</file>

<script>
        // Simple micro-interaction for the Analyze button
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
            const btn = document.getElementById('analyze-btn');
            
            // Simulate button transition based on textarea input
            const textarea = document.querySelector('textarea');
            textarea.addEventListener('input', () => {
                if (textarea.value.length > 20) {
                    btn.className = 'bg-primary-container text-on-primary font-button text-button px-6 py-3 rounded-lg hover:bg-on-primary-fixed-variant transition-all flex items-center gap-2 glow-btn-active';
                    btn.innerHTML = '<span className="material-symbols-outlined text-sm font-light">rocket_launch</span> Launch Semantic Match';
                } else {
                    btn.className = 'bg-surface-variant text-on-surface-variant font-button text-button px-6 py-3 rounded-lg border border-outline-variant hover:bg-surface-container-highest transition-all flex items-center gap-2';
                    btn.innerHTML = '<span className="material-symbols-outlined text-sm font-light">troubleshoot</span> Analyze Brief';
                }
            });
        });
    </script>

<script>
        function togglePassword() {
            const pwdInput = document.getElementById('password');
            const pwdIcon = document.getElementById('password-toggle-icon');
            if (pwdInput.type === 'password') {
                pwdInput.type = 'text';
                pwdIcon.textContent = 'visibility_off';
            } else {
                pwdInput.type = 'password';
                pwdIcon.textContent = 'visibility';
            }
        }

        // Simple Tab Logic Demo
        document.getElementById('tab-register').addEventListener('click', function() {
            this.classList.add('bg-surface-container-lowest', 'text-on-surface', 'shadow-sm');
            this.classList.remove('text-on-surface-variant', 'hover:text-on-surface');
            
            const signinBtn = document.getElementById('tab-signin');
            signinBtn.classList.remove('bg-surface-container-lowest', 'text-on-surface', 'shadow-sm');
            signinBtn.classList.add('text-on-surface-variant', 'hover:text-on-surface');
            
            document.querySelector('button[type="submit"] span').textContent = 'Create Account';
            document.querySelector('.text-center h2').textContent = 'Create an Account';
            document.querySelector('.text-center p').textContent = 'Join MatchInfluence AI to start optimizing.';
            document.getElementById('message-container').classList.add('hidden');
        });

        document.getElementById('tab-signin').addEventListener('click', function() {
            this.classList.add('bg-surface-container-lowest', 'text-on-surface', 'shadow-sm');
            this.classList.remove('text-on-surface-variant', 'hover:text-on-surface');
            
            const registerBtn = document.getElementById('tab-register');
            registerBtn.classList.remove('bg-surface-container-lowest', 'text-on-surface', 'shadow-sm');
            registerBtn.classList.add('text-on-surface-variant', 'hover:text-on-surface');
            
            document.querySelector('button[type="submit"] span').textContent = 'Sign In';
            
            // Handle mobile/desktop title appropriately if possible, simplified here
            const h2 = document.querySelector('.text-center h2');
            if(window.innerWidth >= 768) {
                h2.textContent = 'Welcome Back';
            } else {
                document.querySelector('.md\\:hidden').textContent = 'Welcome Back';
            }
            
            document.querySelector('.text-center p').textContent = 'Sign in to access your intelligence dashboard.';
            document.getElementById('message-container').classList.add('hidden');
        });
    </script>
</file>

<file path="extract.py">
import re

with open('Frontend snitch.xml', 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    content = f.read()

files = re.findall(r'<file path="(.*?)">(.*?)</file>', content, re.DOTALL)

css_blocks = []

for path, file_content in files:
    if not path.endswith('.html'): continue
    print(f"Processing {path}...")
    
    # Extract style
    style_match = re.search(r'<style>(.*?)</style>', file_content, re.DOTALL)
    if style_match:
        css_blocks.append(f"/* From {path} */\n{style_match.group(1).strip()}")
    
    # Extract body
    body_match = re.search(r'<body[^>]*>(.*?)</body>', file_content, re.DOTALL)
    if body_match:
        body_content = body_match.group(1).strip()
        # Convert class= to className=
        body_content = re.sub(r'\bclass=', 'className=', body_content)
        # Convert for= to htmlFor=
        body_content = re.sub(r'\bfor=', 'htmlFor=', body_content)
        
        out_name = path.split('/')[0] + '.tsx_snippet'
        with open(out_name, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as out:
            out.write(body_content)

# Write aggregated CSS
with open('extracted_styles.css', 'w', encoding='utf-8') as out:
    out.write('\n\n'.join(css_blocks))

print("Extraction complete.")
</file>

- Be aware that this file may contain sensitive information. Handle it with
  the same level of security as you would the original repository.
</usage_guidelines>

<script>
        // Simple micro-interaction for the Analyze button
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
            const btn = document.getElementById('analyze-btn');
            
            // Simulate button transition based on textarea input
            const textarea = document.querySelector('textarea');
            textarea.addEventListener('input', () => {
                if (textarea.value.length > 20) {
                    btn.className = 'bg-primary-container text-on-primary font-button text-button px-6 py-3 rounded-lg hover:bg-on-primary-fixed-variant transition-all flex items-center gap-2 glow-btn-active';
                    btn.innerHTML = '<span class="material-symbols-outlined text-sm font-light">rocket_launch</span> Launch Semantic Match';
                } else {
                    btn.className = 'bg-surface-variant text-on-surface-variant font-button text-button px-6 py-3 rounded-lg border border-outline-variant hover:bg-surface-container-highest transition-all flex items-center gap-2';
                    btn.innerHTML = '<span class="material-symbols-outlined text-sm font-light">troubleshoot</span> Analyze Brief';
                }
            });
        });
    </script>

<script>
        function togglePassword() {
            const pwdInput = document.getElementById('password');
            const pwdIcon = document.getElementById('password-toggle-icon');
            if (pwdInput.type === 'password') {
                pwdInput.type = 'text';
                pwdIcon.textContent = 'visibility_off';
            } else {
                pwdInput.type = 'password';
                pwdIcon.textContent = 'visibility';
            }
        }

        // Simple Tab Logic Demo
        document.getElementById('tab-register').addEventListener('click', function() {
            this.classList.add('bg-surface-container-lowest', 'text-on-surface', 'shadow-sm');
            this.classList.remove('text-on-surface-variant', 'hover:text-on-surface');
            
            const signinBtn = document.getElementById('tab-signin');
            signinBtn.classList.remove('bg-surface-container-lowest', 'text-on-surface', 'shadow-sm');
            signinBtn.classList.add('text-on-surface-variant', 'hover:text-on-surface');
            
            document.querySelector('button[type="submit"] span').textContent = 'Create Account';
            document.querySelector('.text-center h2').textContent = 'Create an Account';
            document.querySelector('.text-center p').textContent = 'Join MatchInfluence AI to start optimizing.';
            document.getElementById('message-container').classList.add('hidden');
        });

        document.getElementById('tab-signin').addEventListener('click', function() {
            this.classList.add('bg-surface-container-lowest', 'text-on-surface', 'shadow-sm');
            this.classList.remove('text-on-surface-variant', 'hover:text-on-surface');
            
            const registerBtn = document.getElementById('tab-register');
            registerBtn.classList.remove('bg-surface-container-lowest', 'text-on-surface', 'shadow-sm');
            registerBtn.classList.add('text-on-surface-variant', 'hover:text-on-surface');
            
            document.querySelector('button[type="submit"] span').textContent = 'Sign In';
            
            // Handle mobile/desktop title appropriately if possible, simplified here
            const h2 = document.querySelector('.text-center h2');
            if(window.innerWidth >= 768) {
                h2.textContent = 'Welcome Back';
            } else {
                document.querySelector('.md\\:hidden').textContent = 'Welcome Back';
            }
            
            document.querySelector('.text-center p').textContent = 'Sign in to access your intelligence dashboard.';
            document.getElementById('message-container').classList.add('hidden');
        });
    </script>
</body></html>

## Brand & Style

The design system is built upon a foundation of clinical precision and executive exclusivity. It targets high-stakes professionals who value efficiency, discretion, and curated information. The aesthetic is a fusion of **Minimalism** and **Modern Corporate**, leaning heavily into whitespace and structural integrity to evoke a sense of calm authority.

The emotional response should be one of quiet confidence. Every element serves a functional purpose, stripped of extraneous ornamentation. Visual interest is generated through meticulous alignment and the interplay of high-quality typography rather than decorative flourishes. The interface acts as a silent partner, providing a frictionless, high-end experience that feels private and bespoke.

**Iconography Style:**
- Use a custom-selected, ultra-light stroke icon set (0.75px to 1px weight).
- Icons must be geometric and non-rounded.
- Avoid filled variants; use "hollow" outlines to maintain visual lightness.
- Icons should be used sparingly, primarily as functional signifiers rather than decorative elements.

**Header Architecture:**
- Absolute removal of decorative logos or brand marks from the primary navigation.
- Use plain-text identifiers in a specific weight or a singular, abstract geometric glyph if a visual anchor is required.
- The header should prioritize utility and breadcrumb navigation over brand presence.

## Colors

This design system utilizes a monochromatic, high-contrast palette anchored by **Navy Blue (#1e293b)**. This primary shade represents stability and institutional intelligence. The palette is intentionally restricted to prevent visual fatigue and maintain a clinical atmosphere.

- **Primary (#1e293b):** Used for primary actions, headings, and high-emphasis text.
- **Secondary (#64748b):** Reserved for supporting information, icons, and secondary UI elements.
- **Neutral (#f8fafc):** The canvas color. It provides a cool-toned, clinical white background that feels more premium than pure hex white.
- **Accents:** Use a subtle Slate tint for borders and dividers to maintain low-contrast structural boundaries.

## Typography

Typography is the primary vehicle for the brand’s "curated" feel. We employ a tripartite system:
1. **Hanken Grotesk** for headlines: Provides a sharp, contemporary, and engineered feel.
2. **Inter** for body text: Offers maximum readability and a neutral, systematic tone.
3. **JetBrains Mono** for labels and data: Injects a clinical, precise, and "raw data" aesthetic to metadata and small callouts.

Tighten letter spacing on large headlines to create a "locked-in" executive look. Use generous line height for body copy to ensure the content feels airy and accessible despite the clinical tone.

## Layout & Spacing

The layout follows a **Fixed Grid** philosophy on desktop to create a sense of contained, organized information, transitioning to a fluid model on mobile.

- **Grid:** 12-column system with 24px gutters.
- **Rhythm:** All spacing must be a multiple of the 4px base unit. 
- **Alignment:** Use rigid, left-aligned compositions. Avoid centered text blocks to maintain a professional, document-style flow.
- **Negative Space:** Use "aggressive" padding (e.g., 80px or 120px) between major sections to isolate ideas and reinforce the curated nature of the content.

## Elevation & Depth

This design system rejects heavy shadows in favor of **Low-contrast outlines** and **Tonal layers**. 

Depth is communicated through:
1. **Subtle Borders:** 1px solid lines using a light Slate (#e2e8f0) to define sections.
2. **Layered Grays:** Using slight variations in background color (e.g., moving from #f8fafc to #f1f5f9) to indicate a nested element or a "raised" card.
3. **Zero Shadow Policy:** No drop shadows are permitted on standard UI components. If depth is absolutely required (e.g., a modal), use a single, highly diffused 10% opacity Navy blur without an offset.

## Shapes

The shape language is strictly **Sharp (0px)**. 

To reinforce the clinical and architectural nature of the system, all buttons, input fields, cards, and containers must have square corners. This non-rounded approach differentiates the product from "friendly" consumer apps and aligns it with professional tools and high-end editorial design.

## Components

**Buttons:**
- Primary: Solid Navy (#1e293b) background, white text, sharp corners. No gradients.
- Secondary: 1px Navy border, transparent background, Navy text.
- Interaction: On hover, primary buttons shift to a slightly lighter Slate; secondary buttons gain a very light Gray fill.

**Input Fields:**
- Minimalist underline or 1px border on all four sides. 
- Focus state: Border weight increases to 2px or changes to the primary Navy color.
- Labels use the "label-sm" (JetBrains Mono) style positioned above the field.

**Cards:**
- Flat design with 1px Slate borders. 
- No shadows. 
- Internal padding should be generous (min 32px) to allow content to "breathe."

**Lists & Tables:**
- Heavily utilized for data-rich views.
- Use horizontal dividers only; remove vertical lines to maintain a clean flow.
- Table headers use the Mono label style for a technical, ledger-like feel.

**Chips/Tags:**
- Rectangular, sharp-edged boxes with a light gray background and Navy text. No icons within chips unless essential for status.
</file>
